icerikOnay.aciklama: Posts your agency prepared for you. Review them, then approve or request a revision by describing what should change.
icerikOnay.bos: No content is waiting for your approval right now.
icerikOnay.revizyonIpucu: Describe what should change (e.g. image, tone, date).
icerikOnay.revizyonGonderildi: Your revision request was sent to the agency.

sayfa.aciklama: The content below is awaiting your approval. No sign-in needed; the link can be used only once.

bulunamadi.metin: The link is invalid or was removed. You can ask your agency for a new one.

kullanildi.metin: A decision has already been made for this content.
kullanildi.onay: This content has already been approved.
kullanildi.revizyon: A revision was requested; your agency will update it and send it again.

suresi_doldu.metin: Ask your agency for a new approval link.

iptal.metin: Your agency withdrew or renewed this approval request.

onay.metin: Thank you! The content will be prepared for publishing at the scheduled time.

revizyon.metin: Your agency will update the content according to your note and send it again.

hata.genel: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
hata.ag: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
hata.yetki: You are not allowed to do this.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many requests. Try again in a few seconds.
hata.sinir: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
hata.kullanildi: A decision has already been made for this content.
hata.not_gerekli: Please write a short note for the revision.
hata.not_uzun: The note is too long (max 2,000 characters).
hata.hedef_degisti: The content changed meanwhile; please reload.
hata.mesgul: The action collided with another request; try again.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: You do not have content permission in this account.
